ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35% high-intensity white pixels localized to the distal regions and 65% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central and peduncle areas.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white pigmentation zones located on the distal 30% of each lobe; central 40% of the fluke area is dominated by solid black pixels. Secondary black mottling (circular clusters) is mapped within the distal white zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 75 degrees; the vertex is partially occluded by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with variable pixel amplitude; distinct macro-notches (deep indentations) are visible on the inner trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve; proximal trailing edge exhibits positive convexity, transitioning to a concave upward sweep at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity elevated pixel clusters (barnacles) are localized on the far-left and far-right distal leading edges; dark circular pixel clusters are distributed across the white distal pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multi-directional, high-contrast white linear pixel streaks (rake marks) crossing the black pigmentation of the central fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant linear rake marks across the ventral surface and visible barnacle colonization at the lobe tips.
